tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 25 s, the dialog still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' (Bahn 1 moving at 16 cm/s); it did not ask for Bahn 2. Betriebsprotokoll still 'Noch keine Ereignisse.' (Tester note: click, wait and snapshot were sent in one message; per Playwright timestamps the 25 s wait followed the click.)
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears
Observed failure: After 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and clicking Start, the control correctly did not start (badge 'Gestoppt', Start still shown). But the message never became visible: a toast element containing 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' exists in the DOM but Playwright reported it hidden on every check right after the click, it was absent from the snapshot, and a screenshot after a third click showed no warning.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Bahn 1 moves clockwise and Bahn 2 counter-clockwise along the main loop; the two trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: Bahn 1 was seen moving clockwise (bottom straight -> left curve up -> top straight left to right -> right curve down). Bahn 2 went from the calibration point back to the loop, evaded to the siding, then on the main loop moved right-to-left along the bottom straight and up the left curve past Haltestelle 4, i.e. also clockwise. In no counting screenshot pair did Bahn 2 move counter-clockwise; both trains circled in the same sense.
Steps completed before failure: 11
